rationale: The plan correctly identifies raw STAR/featureCounts integer counts, rejects tximport, and runs DESeq2 with ~condition, in-model size factors, a justified >=10-in-3-samples filter, BH at 0.05 and apeglm shrinkage, while stating the n=3 power caveat and a report-don't-drop outlier policy. Gaps: the reference level is not explicitly set (relevel to control) despite apeglm needing a coefficient name, and there is no stated policy for a shallow library. Enrichment was neither asked for nor well warranted at n=3; the plan runs it anyway with an ambiguous ranking metric ('LFC/lfcSE or stat'), no gene-set version, no size window, and no explicit ORA universe. Reporting is otherwise complete with versions, thresholds, tested/significant counts and design caveats.
